title: Collect package names from npm's most-depended-upon list
task: Build a candidate list of popular npm packages when no bulk API exists.

steps.note: Enrich the names with api.npmjs.org/downloads/point/last-week/<pkg>, which does have an API.

caveats: Rule of thumb: scrape what has no API to get names, then use the API that exists to enrich them.
npmjs.com may show a challenge page to automated traffic. A real signed-in browser usually avoids it.
author: jeet-dhandha
